name: Linksoon
name_zh: 深圳市灵枢动力有限公司
summary: Linksoon develops precision transmission components and integrated robot joints. Its portfolio includes LSH harmonic joint modules, LSP planetary joint modules, and LH hat-type and LC cup-type harmonic reducers for humanoid, collaborative and industrial robots. The Shenzhen company was founded in 2025 and states that it received strategic investment from Fenda Technology.
